bio.text: Michael “Misha” Novakhov was elected to Assembly District 45 on November 8, 2022; the district includes parts of Sheepshead Bay, Midwood, Manhattan Beach, Gravesend and Brighton Beach.
According to his official biography, he is originally from the former USSR and immigrated to the United States with his family.
He worked for 20 years in the radio business and in 2019 co-founded Freedom FM, a Russian-language radio station.
